:::{#rem-second-derivative-test-zero}
#### The second derivative test can fail to decide

If $f''(c) = 0$ at a [flat point](#def-flat-point) $c$,
the [second derivative test](#thm-second-derivative-test) does not decide:
$f$ may be smallest at $c$ among nearby points, largest there, or neither
(@exm-second-derivative-test).

:::
